newsitem.title: FRANCE: French public audit ready around July 14 -minister.
newsitem.headline: French public audit ready around July 14 -minister.

text.p: French Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn said on Tuesday an audit of public finances promised by the new Socialist government should be ready by around July 14.
Strauss-Kahn told French radio the audit, pledged during the recent election campaign, would be formally announced by Prime Minister Lionel Jospin in a speech to parliament on Thursday.
"It will take about a month, so it will be (ready) around July 14," he said.
